news.headline: Hazel Selected for Air Force SBIR Phase I to Accelerate Proposal Evaluations

paragraphs: Hazel sells procurement software to government agencies, covering the work from solicitation through award. It is built for local, state and federal buyers, including cities, counties, schools and special districts.

Requesting departments start with a guided intake that flags missing information, budget codes and inconsistencies at submission. A scope review step checks draft scopes for gaps, risks and potential barriers to entry for small business before they go public. A solicitation builder drafts documents from an agency's own templates, from RFx packages to purchase orders and contracts. The tool recommends rather than rewrites, and the person using it decides what changes. Agencies can begin with a single module or run the whole lifecycle.

The company says agencies on the platform manage more than $50 billion in annual procurement. One case study describes a large state producing first drafts in under 15 minutes instead of more than 40 hours. The site states SOC 2 Type II certification. It also says agency data stays with the agency and is not shared even between departments.

quote.text: From solicitation to award, Hazel helps government agencies run faster, fully compliant procurements.
